question: Which of the following state has approved the Mission 'Lal Lakeer' in all villages in February 2021 to monetize property rights and avail benefits offered by government departments, institutions, and banks?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The **Punjab Cabinet** approved the **'Lal Lakir' mission** in all villages.
 
• ‘Lal Lakir’ aims at facilitating villagers to** monetise property rights and availing benefits **provided by government departments, institutions and banks in all villages across the state.
 
• As **no record of rights** is available for such properties within the ‘Lal Lakir’, the same cannot currently be monetised as per real value of the property and no mortgages can be created on such properties.
 
• There are households within the ‘Lal Lakir’, which do not own property other than the areas within the ‘Lal Lakir’, and are thus at a** disadvantage** when it comes to** monetising or realising the real value** of the property.
 
• ‘Lal Lakir’ refers to land that is part of the village **‘abaadi’ (habitation)** and is used for **non-agriculture purposes** only.
 
• The **right of record** of properties within ‘Lal Lakir’ in the villages of the state will be prepared with the cooperation of the government of India under the **SVAMITVA (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas) scheme.**
 
• This will enable **mapping the land, households, habitation and all other areas **falling within ‘Lal Lakir’.
